senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. wds.) [plague,] hornet (collect. noun). Y. Sabb. XIV, beg. 14ᵃ מותר להרוג את הצ׳ וכ׳ you may kill hornets on the Sabbath (because they are dangerous to life). Ib.; Bab.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45</cite> <he>וכן הצ׳ בימי וכ׳</he> the same was the case with the plague of hornets in Joshua’s days; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 102">Yalk. Sam. 102</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537:2">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite> <he>יכול אף הצ׳</he>, read: <he>הצִיפָּה</he>.]—Pl. <he>צִרְעִים</he>, <he>צִרְעִין</he>, <he>צִרְעוֹת</he>. Yalk. Sam. l. c. <he>והיו שתי צ׳ קורעות וכ׳</he> two hornets split the stem &c.; Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:4">Makhsh. VI, 4</cite> <he>דבש צ׳</he> hornets’ honey.
<cite ref="Sotah 36a:10">Sot. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי צ׳ הואי וכ׳</he> there were two plagues of hornets, one in Moses’ days, and one in Joshua’s; a. e.
